subject: Phase 0 07_BSD_Certificate_Globalizer — the faithful unresolved mass 𝔅_k(s) = Σ_{i∈H_k} i^{-s}, s > 1

the_monotonicity_hypothesis_is_not_neede.document_says: 若 certificate system monotone，則 lim 𝔅_k = 0 表示每個固定 class 最終離開 unresolved frontier
the_monotonicity_hypothesis_is_not_neede.why_it_is_unnecessary: s > 1 makes Σ i^{-s} convergent, so dominated convergence gives the implication from pointwise departure alone
the_monotonicity_hypothesis_is_not_neede.rate_note: this family's mass falls like 1/(2k), so it is sampled at k = 39, 401, 4001, 40001 rather than asserted at a single k

faithfulness_is_exact_but_not_numerical.the_design_goal: §0 — a control quantity that will not swallow a single uncertified curve just because most are certified
faithfulness_is_exact_but_not_numerical.why_it_is_only_exact: a class at index i leaves mass i^{-s}, positive in Q but below the last representable bit of the running sum past some index; beyond it a float64 benchmark reports the same number whether that curve is resolved or not

the_use_case_the_weight_inverts.comparison: 10,750 unresolved classes carry mass 8.79371e-06, while ONE unresolved class at index 7 carries 0.0204082 — larger by a factor of 2320.77. 𝔅 ranks a single early failure as worse than ten thousand late ones, which is a property of the weight i^-s and not a defect — but it is the opposite of what §5's 'are high-conductor curves permanently forgotten?' use case needs, and the document does not say so.
